# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.6 Implementation-Blind Horizontal Audit

Scope: frozen SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5; current SCI-VAL Core/Registry/source binding;
SCI-AST RTC-output-grid authority; exact `SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1`;
SCI-MAP r0.6; `SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2`; and
`SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@1`.

The audit inspected only the exact scientific authorities bound by
`SOURCE_MANIFEST_R0.6.md`. It did not inspect implementation, schema,
configuration, tests, reductions, validation evidence, generated science
products, production behavior, or historical defaults.

| Audit route | Disposition | Basis and remaining gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conditional contract coherence | Coherent for owner review | Quantity, stable occurrence, same-`n` AST join, typed gates, one-hot projection, unique-original exposure, response roles, covariance states, and atomic coadd responsibilities compose without ownership conflict |
| Source-closed numerical observation map | Not available | PTC r0.5 supplies the coefficient declaration type but `PTC-OD-010` selects no MAP-facing family; MAP-OD-007 admits no numerical `coverage_cut` domain |
| Response-bearing map | Conditional; claim-specific route not established | Fixed-state, PTC full-procedure, whole-chain, and realized-companion roles are distinct; exact sufficient response for a named claim remains required |
| Uncertainty-qualified map | Conditional; claim-specific route not established | Complete covariance requires all named blocks; partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable states remain honest alternatives |
| Compatible-grid coadd | Conditionally coherent | Requires source-closed member maps and atomic realized evaluation of the exact VAL-governed aggregate profile; response and covariance qualification are role-specific |

Cross-package checks found the PTC and MAP boundary copies byte-identical at
SHA-256 `9a8a51a8c2201ea59b5d62cca9d4fad6206ef130e305006187e5a17c9ec522d6`.
The continuing VAL records preserve `map_upstream_admission@1` as immutable
history, register source-current `@2` and coadd `@1`, and retain VAL as
evaluator/registry rather than policy author. No flag or cause gains universal
MAP action. No direct CAL, PTC-disabled, inferred-no-op, cross-generation,
fractional-projection, crop/pad, reprojection, or mosaic route is introduced.

Result: no scientific inconsistency was found within the bounded conditional
contract. This does not close either numerical hard gate and makes no claim of
implementation conformity, validation, achieved response, observational
performance, freeze, readiness, or production authorization.
